job_scam: Yima kancane ungakabhadali ngomsebenzi kumbe ukuqeqetshwa.
Hlola inkampani lomsebenzi ngomthombo ozikhethela wona.
Cela umuntu omthembayo ukuthi ahlole isithembiso somsebenzi.
phishing: Vula isevisi usebenzisa i-app kumbe ikheli osulaziyo.
Guqula i-password yakho nxa uyabelane ngayo.
romance_scam: Ungathumeli imali kumbe amakhadi ezipho kumuntu ongakahlangani laye.
Thatha isikhathi uhlole indaba yakhe lomuntu omthembayo.
mobile_money_reversal: Xhumana lomnikezeli wakho wokubhadala nge-app yakhe kumbe ngesitatimende.
prize_scam: Hlola ukuthi wangena yini emncintiswaneni lo.
impersonation: Xhumana lalowo muntu ngenombolo kumbe nge-app osulayo.
Cela umuntu omthembayo ukuthi ahlole isicelo lesi.
mule_request: Ungamukeli kumbe uthumele imali yomunye umuntu.
Ungabelani ngemininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho kumbe yokubhadala.
Nxa usuthumele imali, xhumana lebhanga lakho nge-app yalo kumbe ngenombolo esekhadini lakho.
